description: Updates the registration_status of an existing registration (e.g. REGISTERED -> COMPLETED).
validation: registration must exist and belong to organization + branch
status must not be null (registration_status is NOT NULL)

errors.condition: registration not found / not in organization+branch scope
status value is not a recognized registration status, or transition is not allowed from the current status

notes: SCHEMA GAP: registration_status has no CHECK constraint and no enum/lookup FK in any schema version through v25 (database/schema/versions/v25.sql line 842 shows it as plain character varying(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'REGISTERED'). Any string value is currently accepted at the database level - there is no DB-level enforcement of a fixed status set (REGISTERED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, etc.) or of a valid transition sequence. database/api_contracts_test/011_patient_registration.sql only exercises the REGISTERED -> COMPLETED transition; no other transitions, and no rejection of an unrecognized status string, are tested anywhere in the source material.
requires_confirmation: What is the full set of valid registration_status values, and which transitions between them are allowed? Should this be enforced with a CHECK constraint (as accession_tests and sample_collection do for their status columns) or an FK to a status master table (as sample_status_master now does for accession_tests.sample_status)?
